    Profile

    Alexis runs a clinic at a little village in the Saga Region. Always in fear of something, he needs his tranquilizer drip to relax, though he's trusted by the people in the village because of his expert medical skills. It's said that he's developing new medicine in his free time, but no one knows what it's for.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 166cm
    Weight: 50kg
    Birthday: Mar 10
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Medicine in general
    Hobbies: Thievery and developing new medical techniques
    Illust: やもり
    CV: 後藤ヒロキ
